notes: 18 MB is by far the largest file in this folder and the project uses perhaps six numbers from it - 1.225 kg/m3, 288.15 K, 101,325 Pa, 6.5 K/km, 9.80665 m/s2 and R = 287.053 J/kg.K. It is stored whole anyway, because sim/atmosphere.js now decides every published lift figure and the constants in it should be traceable to the document rather than to a web page that quotes it. A scanned government publication is also exactly the kind of thing that quietly disappears behind a redesign. If this repository ever needs to shed weight, this is the first file to reconsider.
